name: Isle of the Vanished
source:
When Anora Stormwood crash-lands on a mysterious island with only her archenemy pilot for company, she finds herself caught in the midst of an unsettling reality. 

Will she be able to survive the perils of monster attacks, enigmatic villages, and the constant presence of her enemy?

[From [url=https://doormendevs.itch.io/isle-of-the-vanished]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当阿诺拉·斯托姆伍德迫降在一座神秘岛屿上时，身边只有她的宿敌飞行员陪伴，她发现自己陷入了令人不安的现实之中。

她能否在怪物袭击、神秘村庄和敌人持续存在的危险中生存下来？

[来自[url=https://doormendevs.itch.io/isle-of-the-vanished]Itch.io[/url]]
